html:
As Ontario’s cities grow and infrastructure projects expand, the demand for high-quality steel and metal products has never been greater. Dass Metal Products, a division of JDass Group, has positioned itself as a trusted partner for contractors, developers, and builders across Canada.

A Commitment to Quality and Certification

At the heart of Dass Metal Products is a simple principle: quality you can build on. Every product leaving our 300,000 sq. ft. Steel Service Centre in Vaughan is designed to meet the highest standards of durability, reliability, and compliance.

Our certifications, including CSSBI recognition, underscore our commitment to delivering products that contractors and developers can trust. By consistently meeting and exceeding regulatory standards, Dass Metal Products ensures that every project built with our materials stands the test of time.

State-of-the-Art Facilities in Vaughan

Located in Vaughan, Ontario, our facility is one of the region’s most advanced steel service centres. Powered by district energy, the centre reflects our company’s commitment to sustainability and efficiency.

From custom fabrication to on-demand supply, our operations are designed to meet the needs of small contractors and large infrastructure projects alike. With advanced equipment and a dedicated team, we are equipped to deliver on tight deadlines without compromising quality.

Supporting Ontario’s Growth

As Ontario invests heavily in housing, transit, and infrastructure, Dass Metal Products is proud to play a role in building the province’s future. Our steel and metal products are used across a wide range of applications, from residential developments to major transportation projects.

We see ourselves not just as suppliers, but as partners in progress — helping to shape stronger communities by providing the materials that make growth possible.

Leadership that Drives Excellence

Behind every successful division is strong leadership. Backed by the vision ofJaswant Dass (CEO, JDass Group), the strategic guidance of Navjot Dass (Managing Director), and the operational expertise of Preet Dass (COO), Dass Metal Products is aligned with the broader JDass Group mission: sustainable growth, community commitment, and a Canada-first philosophy.

Looking Ahead

With Ontario’s construction market continuing to expand, Dass Metal Products is ready to meet the challenge. We will continue to invest in technology, sustainability, and customer service to ensure that builders across the province — and the country — can depend on us.

Our mission is clear: to be Canada’s trusted partner in steel and metal supply, today and for generations to come.
